description: Secrets for echo-crm security pass. Prefer vault service=echo-crm; env overrides via EnvironmentFile.

keys.purpose: Postgres password for CRM schema. No hardcoded default.
API authentication key (X-Echo-API-Key). Timing-safe compare via security.secure_compare.
Stripe secret for plan upgrade checkout sessions.
Stripe webhook HMAC secret (v1 scheme). Required for /webhooks/stripe in production.

notes: Do not commit secrets. Unit file uses EnvironmentFile=-/etc/echo/echo-crm.env (and siblings).
Dev-only: ECHO_CRM_DEV_MODE=1 allows missing API key / local defaults for tests — never set in production systemd.
Hardcoded PGPASSWORD=echo removed from source and unit; vault first, then env.
